 ET Online | 23 Oct 2026, 03:48 PM IST US President Donald Trump says he asked Google’s CEO to rename the Atlantic Ocean on Google Maps, drawing attention to his remarks about geographical naming. The statement has sparked interest in the intersection of politics and technology, raising questions about digital mapping platforms, official place names and the influence of political leaders.
